terra.problem: Saying the city did not volunteer to be the punchline adds something the text does not say.
The claim that people do not laugh at what they fear is untrue.
The verse says father and mother are treated with contempt. It does not say honor is nowhere in the city.
Saying the three groups have nobody in their corner adds a fact the text does not give.
Calling them the people with the least adds a comparison the passage does not make.
Nobody standing guard in the city is an unsupported claim.
The explanation asserts that fear would have changed things and that the city was not thinking about God at all. The verse says they forgot Him, not those additional things.
The verse says the city forgot God. It does not say nobody in the city was seeking Him.
Sought and forgotten are not close in sound.
“It's not even close” is negative about the baker's answer.
Saying the furnace is set up in Jerusalem risks presenting the furnace picture as a literal furnace.
The verse does not say that no rain means nobody washed the land, or that the land is dry and dusty.
The explanation treats the land's lack of cleansing as a literal lack of washing, which the verse does not establish.
The passage does not state that exposing deeds with true visions is what a prophet should do.
The text does not say the prophets were not hiding anywhere or that they did not run from the deeds.
